Le ministère de la Poste et des Télécomm: The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications warns Meta regarding the mandatory linking of WhatsApp accounts to an Algerian number
Alger, 10 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le: Algiers, August 10, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications has sent official correspondence to "Meta Platforms" instructing it of the need to maintain the association of every active WhatsApp account in Algeria with a valid mobile phone number duly identified with national operators, the ministry stated in a press release on Monday.
Cette démarche intervient suite au déplo: This move comes following the deployment by the WhatsApp application of the new "Usernames" feature in Algeria, an option allowing users to register and communicate without revealing their phone number.
Tout en précisant qu'il ne s'oppose pas: While specifying that it does not oppose the use of this feature as an additional option — given its benefits in terms of security and user experience enhancement — the ministry emphasized in its correspondence that "any WhatsApp account activated in Algeria must imperatively remain linked to a correct mobile phone number identified by national telephony operators."
À cet effet, le ministère a exigé de la: To this end, the ministry has demanded an official written response from "Meta" confirming the maintenance of this link for every account used on national territory. It also insisted on the prohibition of creating or maintaining accounts based exclusively on a pseudonym without being linked to a phone number.
Selon la même source, la multinationale: According to the same source, the multinational is required to present "a clear execution plan as well as a precise timetable" in the event that specific technical adjustments for the Algerian market prove necessary to comply with this requirement.
Le ministère a affirmé que cette mesure: The ministry affirmed that this measure is "necessary and proportionate," specifying that it in no way contravenes user privacy or the principle of "End-to-End Encryption" guaranteed by the application.
L'objectif de cette instruction est de «: The objective of this instruction is to "guarantee digital trust and accountability," while contributing to the "prevention of fraud, identity theft, and cybercrime," in accordance with the legislative and regulatory framework in force in Algeria.
Enfin, le ministère a exprimé la pleine: Finally, the ministry expressed the full availability of its technical teams to engage in immediate discussions with the representatives of "Meta" and "WhatsApp" to ensure the implementation of these provisions, the statement concluded.
